zh: 她每封邮件结尾都加一个笑脸。
en: She always {signs off|ends} her emails with a smiley face.

zh: 如果有任何问题，随时联系我。
en: If you have any questions, feel free to {reach out to|get in touch with|contact|email|message} me.

zh: 我犯了个错，把邮件发给了错的客户。
en: I {slipped up|messed up|stuffed up|screwed up|made a mistake} and sent the email to the wrong client.

zh: 我已经把会议邀请发出去了。

en: I {look forward to} hearing from you.

zh: 邮件太多了，我根本跟不上。
en: There are so many emails that I can't {keep up with|keep on top of|stay on top of} them all.

zh: 如果想收到我们的新闻通讯，请选择订阅。
en: {Opt in|Sign up} to receive our newsletter.

zh: 开会前我匆匆写了一封邮件。
en: I {dashed off|fired off|knocked out|wrote} a quick email before the meeting.

zh: 你最好把那封邮件的措辞改得缓和一点。
en: You might want to {tone down|soften} the language in that email.

zh: 我今天先下线了，明天见。
en: I'm {logging off|signing off|logging out} for the day. See you tomorrow.

zh: 千万别上那种诈骗邮件的当。
en: Don't {fall for|be fooled by|be taken in by} those scam emails.

zh: 她一个小时之内就回信了。
我休假一周，邮件堆积如山。
en: My emails really {piled up|built up|stacked up} while I was on leave.

zh: 你能帮我把这个消息转告给团队吗？
en: Can you {pass on|relay|forward} this message to the team?
